name: Gold EMA Pullback
description: A trend-continuation setup that waits for a pullback and candle confirmation.

image_reader.method: Detect candle-color clusters from common cool/warm MT5 chart palettes and estimate candle highs, lows, and closes in pixel space. Cool hues are assumed bullish and warm hues bearish.

long_setup.pullback: A recent candle low approaches EMA20 within 0.75 ATR(14).
long_setup.confirmation: Latest detected candle is bullish and closes above the previous candle high.
long_setup.stop_loss: Below the pullback swing low. Skip when risk is greater than 1.5 ATR(14).

short_setup.pullback: A recent candle high approaches EMA20 within 0.75 ATR(14).
short_setup.confirmation: Latest detected candle is bearish and closes below the previous candle low.
short_setup.stop_loss: Above the pullback swing high. Skip when risk is greater than 1.5 ATR(14).

no_trade_when: Fewer than 12 candle groups are detected.
Candle colors are not distinguishable in the screenshot.
EMA trend, pullback, or confirmation conditions are not met.

references.title: Moving Averages - Simple and Exponential
references.relevance: Moving averages smooth price and define trend direction but lag.

references.title: Average True Range (ATR)
references.relevance: ATR measures volatility and does not indicate price direction.

performance_note: This is a research-informed starter rule, not a historically or forward-tested profitable system.
